otherCandidates.finding: Primary README calls its hand-written motif tables guesses/stylized approximations; measured shapes use recording extraction and do not supply reviewed contextual rules. Root directory lists no project LICENSE; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES covers fonts/tikkun, not a general code grant. No code, measured motif data or voice imported.
MIT code license, but primary README/musicology explicitly treats pitches as original interpretations rather than a recovered traditional melody. Not adopted as a historical grammar.

Primary page distinguishes PocketTorah licensed recordings, modern printed-chart transcriptions and permission-only Total Torah recordings. It supplies no general reuse permission for those modern arrangements/permission-only voice. No new assets or code imported.

cohenPrimaryReview.finding: Printed p547hypothetical prophetical Gen22:1 transcribed literally as an additional worked comparison. It is not a complete arbitrary-word grammar. Penitential example still needs unmetered ornament/duration review; p548rare figures remain source leads, not automatically supplied omitted cells. No arbitrary pre-stress note choices inferred.

limits: The complete original feature inventory, all six Kinnor pronunciation grammars/voices, all recovered contextual melody systems and independent singing remain active/incomplete. New source references do not establish Kinnor preset equivalence. Printing deferred.
